title: Check: Crude Oil and Fractional Distillation (B)

questions.stem: Why is fractional distillation able to separate crude oil into fractions?

options.text: The hydrocarbons have different chemical reactions
The hydrocarbons have different densities that make them float or sink
The hydrocarbons have different boiling points depending on chain length

questions.explanation: Fractional distillation separates crude oil because the different hydrocarbons have different boiling points. Longer chain molecules have stronger intermolecular forces and higher boiling points. In the column, each hydrocarbon condenses at the height where the temperature matches its boiling point.
